_notes: lanePERF4 v100. EDITOR-ONLY (not copied to StreamingAssets). Read by Editor/PerfMemApply.cs. Every step is a dry run unless the command line has -apply, and each step has its own enabled flag (default false). Steps change SCENE objects or TEXTURE IMPORT SETTINGS only; nothing else.

E1.note: Removes the inactive MetaHumanHead object (MHHeadBuilder + MHHeadAttach + keepAlive materials) from the scene so the build stops shipping its textures (about 87 MB) and shader variants. mhhead_attach.json enabled=false: nothing builds the head. Dracula and Joan keep their own heads (Joan: Tripo). VerifyGround and AutoShot -face treat a missing MetaHumanHead as 'not active'. Re-add with Hades > MetaHuman > Integrate if ever wanted.

rules.note: the arena floor: LOD0 4096 textures 299 MB + LOD1 96 MB + LOD2 37 MB. The floor is flat and always near: LOD1/LOD2 never show a different silhouette. The instance is unpacked (PrefabUtility.UnpackPrefabInstance, OutermostRoot) so its LOD1/LOD2 child objects can be deleted; LODGroup keeps LOD0 with the old cull threshold.

terrainDuplicates.note: terrain_ground.glb is the only terrain in the build. terrain_ground_lite / terrain_midground / terrain_midground_lite (about 80 MB each on disk) are not referenced by the scene or the build report (checked in the v92 build report), so they cost import time only: listed, not touched.

E5.note: Texture import settings of the rows in texture_plan.json (TextureImporter files only). Dry run prints the real runtime memory of each file now; apply sets the override, reimports and prints the real memory after.
